title: Understanding Confidence Intervals
text: Confidence intervals provide a range of values that likely contain the true parameter value. If a confidence interval includes $$0$$, it suggests that the parameter might not have a significant effect.

title: Model A Parameters
text: Model A includes parameters for height in inches and centimeters, and weight in pounds and kilograms. Consider how these might affect the confidence intervals.

title: Analyzing Model B
text: Does Model B include height in inches or weight in pounds?

title: Parameter Redundancy
text: Including both height in inches and centimeters, or weight in pounds and kilograms, might introduce redundancy. This can affect the confidence intervals of the parameters.

title: Confidence Interval for $$\theta_{cm}$$
text: Given the redundancy in Model A, is it likely that the confidence interval for $$\theta_{cm}$$ includes 0?
